title: client-changelog configuration
description: Configuration for client-changelog (changelog.config.json at the repo root).

dir.description: Folder, relative to the repo root, that holds the month files.

title.description: Title used in month file headings: "# <title> — November 2026".

currency.description: Currency symbol for complimentary entries, e.g. "$", "€", "£", "₹".

sources.description: Source keywords accepted besides commit hashes and "pending", e.g. "manual", "sanity", "shopify".

ignorePaths.description: Files or folders, relative to the repo root. Commits that only touch these (and the changelog folder) don't need an entry.

sections.description: Entry sections, in order. Used for new month files and the agent instructions.
